_meta.purpose: Single SSOT for Tailwind utility allow/block — extracted from typography/radius/opacity/elevation/color spec.md 禁止 lists. Hook reads this(not grep spec.md)to enforce token-first discipline. New token additions or removals → update here first, spec.md cite registry.
_meta.provider_view_policy: .claude/.agents/.codex projections are generated discovery adapters only; they are never registry owners or edit targets.
_meta.rationale: World-class DS(Atlassian @atlaskit/tokens / Carbon @carbon/themes / Ant ConfigProvider / Polaris polaris-tokens)用 registry + lint, 不靠 grep 各處 spec.md。Rule-of-3 violation 已存在(典型禁止 list 在 3 個 spec.md 各寫一份)— 本檔抽 SSOT。

exceptions._added: 2026-05-17 per audit Dim 47 codex 比稿後 codify;補 anatomy stories Inspector panel UI 跟 DS surface 分層 carve-out

anatomy_stories_inspector.scope: *.anatomy.stories.tsx — Inspector panel / Side legend / Section H3 decoration UI
anatomy_stories_inspector.rationale: Anatomy stories Inspector panel 是 storybook-internal 教學工具 UI(展示元件結構的 side legend / footnote / uppercase header),非 DS component surface。需視覺辨識(uppercase label + 寬 letter-spacing / 小字 metadata)跟 DS 主元件 typography 分層。對齊 Carbon storybook addon、Material storybook addon 共識:tool UI 不受 token-first 約束。`leading-none` 2026-05-21 D1 codex 抓 badge.anatomy L117/118 後加入(10-11px monospace inspector label 需要緊湊 line-height,跟 DS body/body-lg `leading-compact 1.3` 場景分層)。
anatomy_stories_inspector.audit_dim_53_fix: Dim 47 sub-agent 抓 anatomy stories tracking-wider / font-semibold / text-[NN] / leading-none 多處違反 = false positive(本例外段 codify 後豁免)

token_stories_section_label.scope: packages/design-system/src/tokens/**/*.stories.tsx — SectionLabel helper(uppercase + wider tracking section header)
token_stories_section_label.rationale: Token stories(color / typography / radius / elevation / opacity / uiSize / layoutSpace / density)是 token 展示 storybook,用 SectionLabel(`uppercase + tracking-wider`)分區 swatch 群組,跟 anatomy stories Inspector panel 同 storybook-internal teaching UI 性質,非 DS component surface。Phase A audit 2026-05-21 codify。

principles_stories_codepre.rationale: Code sample 區塊用 <pre><code> + monospace font,需小字呈現程式碼 — 跟 DS prose 不同層級。Polaris / Carbon storybook code blocks 同樣使用 smaller font。

icon_as_text_and_numeric_in_circle.scope: Production tsx — icon-as-text / numeric-in-circle / single-line short text in fixed-h container
icon_as_text_and_numeric_in_circle.rationale: 2026-05-23 Path B codify per user verbatim「或是其實根本不用分?」+「照你建議」:統一 leading-none,不分 fixed-box vs derived-h。對齊 Material UI Avatar `line-height: 1` / Polaris Badge `line-height: 1` / Carbon Tag(不顯式設,等效 1)世界級共識。視覺驗證:固定高度容器 + items-center 主導,line-height 1.0 vs 1.3 vs 1.5 視覺零差別(playwright probe `scripts/probe-leading-migration.mjs` Steps step-number box delta = 0px)。廢除原 2026-05-21 F1 Badge 從 leading-none → leading-compact migration(over-engineered,違 mindset #1 不取巧不發明)+ 原 production_layout_positioning_anchor exception(改 affirmative canonical 不需 exception)。
current_consumers: Badge/badge.tsx — count badge in fixed h-4 circle
Avatar/avatar.tsx — initial letter in fixed w-N h-N circle
OverflowIndicator/overflow-indicator.tsx — `+N` numeric in fixed h-5/h-6 circle
Chart/chart.tsx:247 — recharts tooltip tight flex layout
icon_as_text_and_numeric_in_circle.non_goal: 本 canonical 不適用 body / paragraph / heading typography(那些走 typography.allow `leading-compact` / `leading-normal` token)

block.leading_numeric: leading-{N} 與 Tailwind 預設的 leading-tight / snug / relaxed / loose(use leading-compact / leading-normal token;enforcement typography-leading-numeric)
block.tracking_raw_rationale: Block raw Tailwind tracking-* utility(unscoped letter-spacing leaks 跨元件不一致)。需要 wider letter-spacing 場景必 codify role-specific semantic utility — 例如 `tracking-shortcut`(鍵盤快捷鍵 hint,0.1em,對應 --tracking-shortcut token)。新 role 必走 typography.css 新增 `--tracking-<role>` + `@utility tracking-<role>`,再 allow 進本 registry。

radius.allow_note: allow 必須逐字等於 radius.spec.md「四檔」表的 class 欄 + 「唯一的 bracket 寫法」(閘 scripts/token-allowlist-invariant.mjs);rounded-[inherit] 是 passthrough 非 radius 值(clip 到父容器圓角,token utility 無法表達;anchor scroll-area.tsx Viewport)— 唯一合法 arbitrary bracket。block.out_of_range = Tailwind 4.2.2 預設刻度(xs / sm / md / lg / xl / 2xl / 3xl / 4xl)裡不在 allow 的名字(同一支閘拿 node_modules/tailwindcss/theme.css 逐名比對);rounded-xs:2026-11-15 2px 這一檔改名 sm 之後,xs 回到 Tailwind 預設、不歸設計系統管

block.philosophy: Single semantic token(0.45)vs Tailwind multi-tier(對齊 Polaris / Material / Apple 單值哲學)
DS 採 2-tier elevation(100 / 200)語意而非 Tailwind size ladder

spacing.allow_canonical: 版面間距用 layout-space token(gap-[var(--layout-space-tight)] 等,layoutSpace.spec.md);寫入當下 check_layout_space_magic_numbers.sh 在產品程式擋所有數字 p / m / gap,只有下面 canonical_micro_geometry 證明是微距的 gap-1 / gap-2 放行

canonical_micro_geometry.rationale: gap-1/2 只在同行或有界 nearby 證據可機械證明為 inline item/control、semantic homogeneous list、toolbar、或 layoutSpace rule-5 grouped horizontal fields 時是固定 micro geometry。一般 flex/grid/section gap-1/2 仍屬 macro 候選並阻擋；同行混入 p-/m-/space-* magic 也不能被 micro 證據隱藏。

warn.rationale: <4px gap 通常違反 item-anatomy slot 幾何。Allow exception in spec.md(Skeleton bone / inline action 等)but flag for human review.
Fraction width 通常 inside DS component = layout SSOT 漂移。Allow if component spec owns layout(eg. Field labelWidth 比例)but flag。

block.rationale: shadcn compat alias 不聯動 DS dark mode。改用 direct token(--surface-raised / --fg-muted / --error 等)
block.rationale_path: CLAUDE.md `# 失敗記憶索引` shadcn compat alias 回流

block.rationale: primitive 色名作 utility = 越過 semantic 層。依用途選語意色(color.spec.md「表面分層」「文字層級」「muted / secondary」等用途表),不要換成 var() bracket 讀原料(bg-[var(--color-blue-6)] 同樣是越過語意層,color.spec.md「禁止事項」;只有 Tag / Avatar / Calendar 的類別色例外,token-registry.json --color- 那一列)。enforcement primitive-color-family 的色相 ⊇ primitives.css 的色相 ∪ Tailwind 預設色相(閘 scripts/token-allowlist-invariant.mjs)
